```{python}
#| label: fig-impl-choices
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Taxonomy of digital circuit implementation approaches: custom design versus semicustom design, the latter split into cell-based (standard cells, macro cells) and array-based (pre-diffused gate arrays, pre-wired FPGAs) styles."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc='white',
                           ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5)


def link(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ym = (y0 + y1) / 2
    ax.plot([x0, x0, x1, x1], [y0, ym, ym, y1], 'k-', lw=1.0)


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.6))

box(ax, 7.0, 5.4, 5.2, 0.8, 'Digital circuit implementation approaches')
box(ax, 3.4, 3.9, 2.2, 0.75, 'Custom')
box(ax, 10.6, 3.9, 2.4, 0.75, 'Semicustom')
box(ax, 8.1, 2.4, 2.4, 0.75, 'Cell-based')
box(ax, 13.85, 2.4, 2.4, 0.75, 'Array-based')
box(ax, 6.6, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0, 'Standard\ncells')
box(ax, 9.6, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0, 'Macro\ncells')
box(ax, 12.5, 0.8, 2.3, 1.0, 'Pre-diffused\n(gate arrays)')
box(ax, 15.2, 0.8, 2.1, 1.0, 'Pre-wired\n(FPGA)')

link(ax, 7.0, 5.0, 3.4, 4.28)
link(ax, 7.0, 5.0, 10.6, 4.28)
link(ax, 10.6, 3.52, 8.1, 2.78)
link(ax, 10.6, 3.52, 13.85, 2.78)
link(ax, 8.1, 2.02, 6.6, 1.3)
link(ax, 8.1, 2.02, 9.6, 1.3)
link(ax, 13.85, 2.02, 12.5, 1.3)
link(ax, 13.85, 2.02, 15.2, 1.3)

ax.set_xlim(1.8, 16.4)
ax.set_ylim(0.1, 6.0)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
